sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Ta-to-Nb contrast yields +.0243…+.0525 lambda and Tc+1.523 K with path0, force0 and .130 GPa stress. Mo-to-W alternative is an actual contrary case: TiNb2Mo has larger lambda and Tc; TiV2W also better. This candidate uses the former controlled route and never rewrites the failed general W enhancement hypothesis.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.002 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.13 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Ta-to-Nb role construction in TiNb2W against TiNbTaW. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Use existing Nb/Ta minority-role mode/orbital evidence. Favorable: specific Ta-to-Nb paired gain survives; adverse: its channel competition reverses; ambiguous: only wider finite band envelope or nominal electrons are available. Retain failed Mo-to-W edge.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
